Today, Mew came in for a consultation and underwent the Upper Lip Lift program, a technique to lift the upper lip (cat lip) 👄 🐈
at 📍Lemaster Surgery Clinic.

The nursing team took excellent care of me and constantly offered encouragement. The clinic is decorated in a clean and beautiful style. The operating room was very clean and met high standards, which made me feel very reassured. During the procedure, the doctor was very gentle and meticulous in every case. I was very impressed! 🤍🫶🏻

I had lip surgery and rhinoplasty here. The doctor was very meticulous with the sutures. After the procedure, my lips look thinner and more shapely, and my nose, which was wide, now looks much smaller. 👍🏻👍🏻 …
The lip correction makes them look softer. There's still a little swelling, so we'll see how it turns out in the long term. Right now, they look better than before the procedure.

The clinic is clean, the doctor is kind, and the staff are very helpful. I will definitely use their services again if I have the opportunity. The clinic is close to Bang Saen beach and has a fantastic view.
